# ChatGHS AI Travel Concierge (ai.gethotelstays.com)

> ChatGHS is the official AI travel companion and intelligent hotel booking concierge by GetHotelStays. Plan customized Indian travel itineraries, discover verified hotels, book 3hr/6hr/12hr micro-stays, and complete reservations with only a 12% deposit.

## Core Capabilities
- **Instant AI Hotel Discovery**: Conversational hotel search across 10,000+ verified properties in Delhi, Goa, Jaipur, Mumbai, Manali, Shimla, Udaipur, and Bangalore.
- **Customized Tour Itineraries**: Generates bespoke multi-day itineraries matching budget, duration, and traveler type.
- **Micro-Stay Matching**: Finds hourly transit hotels near airports (DEL, BOM, BLR) and major railway stations (NDLS).
- **Direct In-Chat Booking**: Seamless reservation confirmation with 12% online payment via Razorpay / UPI / International Cards.
